newsitem.title: LESOTHO: LESOTHO'S KING CALLS COUNCIL OF STATE ON CRISIS.
newsitem.headline: LESOTHO'S KING CALLS COUNCIL OF STATE ON CRISIS.

text.p: Lesotho's King Letsie has summoned a meeting of the country's council of state to discuss the political crisis in the kingdom, officials said on Friday.

Speaker John Kolane told the national assembly the council would meet at 11 a.m. on Monday and officials said the meeting was expected to review the crisis which followed Prime Minister Ntsu Mokhehle's formation of a new governing party last weekend.

Mokhehle, the ageing and ailing prime minister, formed the Lesotho Congress for Democracy Party with a faction of the ruling Basotholand Congress Party (BCP), taking with him a majority of the 65 members of parliament to form a new party in power.
Members of the BCP who are now in opposition walked out of parliament on Wednesday in protest.
The council of state includes the prime minister, speaker, two judges and the heads of the defence force and police, as well as a representative of the 22 top chiefs in the country.
